arithmetic_note: Percentages are 100 * (candidate - current) / current for the same replicate/profile. Descriptive differences only; no new statistical classification or A21 noise judgement. Percentiles were copied from original exact-sample metadata; no request samples or histogram bins were reprocessed.

recommendation.decision: Do not promote this candidate to the selected final product on this experiment alone. Preserve it as an isolated allocation/CPU experiment.
reasons: All three streaming pairs have sharply lower sampled managed allocation and CPU; all twelve cells passed original correctness/service/drain predicates.
All three server-stream p99 and all three client-stream p99 pairs are higher in the candidate. Duplex and unary latency are mixed.
Candidate last-active and after-idle RSS are higher in all six pairs; lower allocation did not demonstrate lower retained process memory.
No mean, formal A21 noise judgement, overload/capacity result or thirty-minute evidence is claimed.
source_based_unmeasured_costs: The optional 16 KiB grant adds synchronous native acquisition/release; managed-credit drop calls host.reap(). These data do not identify it as the latency cause.
Each active small-mode message holds an extra 16 KiB grant within unchanged limits, increasing unmeasured high-concurrency admission pressure.
An unhinted growing message retains initial/full arrays and copies its advanced prefix; optional fallback handles an internal resource_limit exception. No timed per-path counts exist.
recommendation.required_before_later_retention_claim: Retain cleanup correctness and resource/error constraints, build native/package from the actual same selected commit, run the unchanged EA5 formal comparison, and complete capacity and long acceptance.
